readers.stranger: A stranger sees none of the identifiers. Order numbers and the folder path are redacted, and the customer's contact details are held back.
readers.supplier: The supplier already holds its own order numbers. The customer's email and phone number stay with the bakery, and the local folder path means nothing to them.
readers.team: The team already knows every identifier on this page. Nothing needs hiding.
